reason: Provides native DeepSeek Harness tools for arXiv search, paper summarization, translation, and literature-survey generation using extracted paper text and the harness LLM service.

summaries.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具搜索 arXiv 论文，并对论文进行总结、翻译和文献综述生成。
summaries.en: Provides native DeepSeek Harness tools to search arXiv papers and summarize, translate, or generate literature surveys from them.

capabilities: Downloads and extracts paper text from HTML or PDF sources
Uses an LLM service to summarize, translate, and generate literature surveys
Stores extracted paper text in a local cache
Runs selected operations as background jobs
